title: Grateful Dead Live at Denver Coliseum on 1973-11-21
source: MSR > DAT > CD > Samsung SW-232B extraction (EAC v0.95 prebeta 4) > CDWave v1.71 (tracking) > sector boundary verification (shntool v1.01) > .shn encoding (mkwACT v0.97 beta 1) Patches: MAC (Taped Taped by Glen Finley, Sony 1-point stereo mic > Sony TC-12

ai_review.summary: High‑energy late‑'73 show with smoking Playing in the Band sequences and a powerful Truckin’ > Nobody’s Fault but Mine, captured on a patched soundboard that’s generally good despite some hiss and occasional dropouts.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its inventive set flow – moving Playing in the Band out of the first‑set closer opens up a stellar second set highlighted by Here Comes Sunshine, a blazing Truckin’ > Nobody’s Fault but Mine transition and a thunderous One More Saturday Night. The soundboard source sounds solid overall, though listeners note noticeable hiss and a few nasty patches that slightly detract from an otherwise excellent recording.

ai_rating.rationale: Four detailed reviews give consistently high marks for the show (standout sequences, strong setlist) and note only minor recording flaws; weighted average of show (≈4.5) and recording (≈3.8) yields ~4.4.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear with decent balance, but exhibits noticeable hiss and occasional nasty patches/dropouts, especially during the Truckin' segment.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Moving Playing out of the first‑set closer creates fresh possibilities; second set flows tightly with strong transitions, especially the Truckin' > NFBM sequence.
